standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine base a relatively ample sheaf can be replaced by an ample one

core_obligations: Quote the implication from H-quasi-projectivity to local quasi-projectivity (proof lines 9799-9800).
Reduce to an affine base with a relatively ample invertible sheaf (proof lines 9801-9804).
Replace it by an ample sheaf and obtain the immersion into projective space (proof lines 9805-9810).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the affine case (proof lines 9801-9804).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism is locally quasi-projective exactly when it becomes H-quasi-projective over the members of an open covering of the base. One implication is quoted from the comparison between the two notions. For the other, the question is reduced to an affine base, where the finite type hypothesis supplies a relatively ample invertible sheaf; replacing it by an ample one via the affine criterion makes an immersion into a projective space available, which is precisely H-quasi-projectivity.
